title: The production preflightSpawnFn closure has no test at any tier: the new `r.std…
body: The production preflightSpawnFn closure has no test at any tier: the new `r.stderr instanceof Buffer` decode is proved only by a grep file-assert (AC2), and every unit test injects a fake spawn that returns plain strings, so no test would catch a wrong property name or a broken decode at the real Bun.spawnSync boundary. Risk is low here (it is a one-line mirror of the adjacent stdout guard at :2642, the required `stderr: string` return type is typecheck-enforced, and Bun docs confirm SyncSubprocess.stderr is `Buffer | undefined`), and the pre-existing stdout decode is equally untested, so this diff does not introduce the gap. Worth a follow-up integration test that really spawns a command writing to stderr and asserts the decoded string.

title: Boundary case not asserted: when a failing step produces BOTH streams empty, th…
body: Boundary case not asserted: when a failing step produces BOTH streams empty, the filter+join yields detail === ''. The test at :114-118 sets up exactly that input but asserts only calls.length, never the resulting detail. An explicit expect(result.detail).toBe('') would pin the empty-detail contract that truncatePreflightDetail then renders.

title: PRD authoring note (carried from round 1): AC8's oracle form (`! grep -n 'stder…
body: PRD authoring note (carried from round 1): AC8's oracle form (`! grep -n 'stderr' src/supervisor/plan-preflight.ts | grep -q "step: 'clean-tree'"`) is near-tautological, since the piped grep can essentially never match and the assertion passes regardless of the code. It was verified instead by reading the source (clean-tree at plan-preflight.ts:107-108 is genuinely stdout-only). Future PRDs should avoid oracle shapes that cannot fail.
